answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and shared behavioral evidence: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), rather than being assessed independently. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to swarm-wide capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation reduces recovered stake. Thus crystal, marble, or onyx aliases cannot cheaply distribute blame or preserve economic value.
